source.verified_inputs: Table 5 (p. 9) supplies the battery capacity, service/interzone energy per half hour, self-discharge, charging efficiency, AC/DC nameplates and the economic inputs in check_milan.py. Section 3.4 limits each depot to two units of each type. Table 6 (p. 10) gives vehicle/zone service slots. Section 3 provides shift and travel intervals used in route_time.py.
source.reduction_assumptions: One depot, fixed common order and tasks first, charging investment from zero, AC/DC import only, continuously adjustable grid input up to nameplate; the original Fig. 4 SOC-dependent taper and any positive minimum charging power are omitted. One vehicle per charger per slot and zero-time exchange at slot boundaries. No shared feeder limit. Only the specified depot idle slots are eligible. Service and travel exclude charging.
source.scenario_inputs: One working shift with 90% at both boundaries and an allowed 0-100% battery range. Service placement, the return time and the four post-return plug windows are controlled scenarios.
